description_en: Renames a specified cloud computer to a new name
description_zh: 将指定云电脑的名称修改为新名称
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-desktop-name --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --new-desktop-name DemoComputer01 --desktop-id ecd-gx2x1dhsmucyy0000 --desktop-ids ecd-gx2x1dhsmucyy0000 --user-assign-mode ALL --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDesktopName

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The new name of the cloud computer. The name must meet the following requirements:

The name cannot exceed 64 characters in length.
The name must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), or hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
修改后的云电脑名称。格式要求如下：

不超过64个字符。
必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。
可以包含中文、英文、数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、点号（.）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: new_desktop_name

parameters.help_en: The list of cloud computer IDs
parameters.name: desktop_ids
